name: Cleverly

sources.label: Cleverly cold email service and plans

rows.ours: Published monthly base fees plus $100 per qualified booked meeting. Basic vendor bills are extra.
rows.theirs: Cold email lists Growth as a flat monthly retainer and Scale as pay per lead; request the rates.

rows.ours: A booked call with a decision-maker inside the agreed ICP who has agreed to hear the offer.
rows.theirs: Scale is labeled pay per lead. Confirm the billable lead definition and booking scope before comparing it with a meeting fee.

rows.ours: Email-led campaigns with LinkedIn outreach, handled through to qualified booking.
rows.theirs: Separate LinkedIn, cold email and appointment-setting services; appointment setting can combine LinkedIn, email and calling.

rows.ours: We handle replies and qualified booking. Your team takes the sales calls and closes.
rows.theirs: Its cold email FAQ offers reply handling, qualification and calendar booking with the full-service option.

rows.ours: Basic: you buy domains, mailboxes and tools. Standard and Express: we buy and manage the setup.
rows.theirs: Cold email plans list inbox/domain setup and deliverability management.

rows.ours: The ICP and qualified-booking criteria are agreed before launch. A positive reply alone does not count.
rows.theirs: Appointment qualification is agreed upfront around title, company size, industry, authority and timing.

research_notes: Verified the official LinkedIn, cold email and appointment-setting pages. LinkedIn FAQ says from 397/month. Cold email Growth is a flat monthly retainer; Scale is pay per lead, with no dollar rates listed in those plan blocks. Its full-service email option can handle replies, qualification and calendar booking. The appointment-setting FAQ lists 697–2997/month and says it does not offer pure pay-per-appointment pricing. These are different service-page claims, not evidence that the cold email Scale plan is absent. Do not apply the LinkedIn entry rate or appointment-setting range to all Cleverly services. Do not call Cleverly retainer-only, LinkedIn-only or incapable of booking meetings. Its cold-email 4–6 week results statement is measured after launch; it is not a setup duration comparable to our conditional Express launch. No meeting-guarantee absence, customer complaints, savings percentage or switcher story is established.
decision: For B2B teams buying qualified booked calls, emphasize our explicit booking definition, published fees, choice of infrastructure ownership, Standard/Express guarantee and Express clock. Fairly distinguish a lead fee from a booking fee and ask for a scope-matched quote. Keep other agencies out of this direct comparison.
